summary: Nora can read a conversation, or another room of the group, from an earlier time, so asking what was said yesterday works even after a busy day has buried it.
details: load_transcript and room_read take an optional before time (Hong Kong time, a date alone meaning the end of that day).
When older messages exist, the result tells her the exact value that reads further back, so she can page through a long day without gaps.
limitations: Each read still returns at most 60 messages, and she can make only a few reads per turn.
